title: Cedar Ridge
content:
Cedar Ridge is a wooded hillside community on the north edge of Larkspur Valley, with 140 homesites, two miles of walking trails, and a resident clubhouse.

## Available floor plans
Cedar Ridge offers single-story and two-story designs, including [The Aurora](/homes/the-aurora) and [The Birch](/homes/the-birch). Most homesites back onto protected greenbelt.

## Nearby
Larkspur Valley Elementary is a ten-minute walk, and the Ridgeline shopping center is under five minutes by car. Every new home in Cedar Ridge is eligible for the Northstar Care home plan.
meta_description: Wooded homesites, walking trails, and a resident clubhouse in Larkspur Valley. Explore single-story and two-story floor plans at Cedar Ridge.

title: Willow Creek
content:
Willow Creek is a creekside neighborhood of 96 homes built around a central park and splash pad. Northstar Homes has been building in the Willow Creek area for over a decade, and this community reflects everything we have learned.

## Homes at Willow Creek
Choose from [The Cascade](/homes/the-cascade), [The Everly](/homes/the-everly), and [The Iris](/homes/the-iris). Several move-in-ready homes are available this season.

## Amenities
A 4-acre central park, splash pad, dog run, and a paved loop trail connect every street in the neighborhood.
meta_description: A creekside neighborhood of 96 homes around a central park and splash pad, with move-in-ready homes available now.

title: Harbor Point
content:
Harbor Point sits on the eastern shore of Lake Merritt Reservoir, with lake-view homesites and a private marina for residents.

## Floor plans
Harbor Point features our larger designs, including [The Dakota](/homes/the-dakota) and [The Hawthorne](/homes/the-hawthorne).

## Looking for something quieter?
Our sister community [Pine Valley](/communities/pine-valley) offers larger lots in a forested setting, just twenty minutes inland.
meta_description: Lake-view homesites and a private residents' marina on the eastern shore of Lake Merritt Reservoir.

title: Maple Hollow
content:
Maple Hollow is a walkable, mixed-age community close to downtown Fairhaven. Tree-lined streets, front porches, and a neighborhood café make it easy to get to know your neighbors.

## Floor plans
Maple Hollow offers [The Birch](/homes/the-birch), [The Everly](/homes/the-everly), and [The Glenwood](/homes/the-glenwood).

## Learn more
Read about our [buying process](/faq/buying-process) or browse [financing options](/financing) before your visit.
meta_description: Tree-lined streets, front porches, and a neighborhood café minutes from downtown Fairhaven.

title: Sunset Mesa
content:
Sunset Mesa is a high-desert community with sweeping mountain views, a resort-style pool, and 120 homesites.

## Peace of mind included
Every home at Sunset Mesa comes with the Northstar Classic plan, which covers routine maintenance visits for the first two years of ownership.

## Floor plans
Explore [The Aurora](/homes/the-aurora) and [The Fairview](/homes/the-fairview), both designed for indoor-outdoor living.
meta_description: High-desert living with mountain views, a resort-style pool, and 120 homesites.

title: River Bend
content:
River Bend follows a gentle curve of the Alder River, with a riverside trail, kayak launch, and community fire pits.

## Floor plans
Choose from [The Cascade](/homes/the-cascade) and [The Iris](/homes/the-iris).

Homes at River Bend include energy-efficient windows, tankless water heaters, and solar-ready roofs.
meta_description: River Bend is a riverside community along the Alder River featuring a riverside walking trail, a kayak launch, community fire pits, energy-efficient homes, and a variety of floor plans for growing families, downsizers, and first-time buyers alike.

title: Aspen Grove
content:
Aspen Grove is our newest community, opening in spring 2027 in the foothills above Larkspur Valley.

Join the interest list to get early access to homesite selection and pre-construction pricing. Floor plans will include [The Iris](/homes/the-iris) and a new design to be announced.
meta_description: Coming spring 2027: a new foothills community above Larkspur Valley. Join the interest list for early access.

title: Lakeshore Commons
content:
Lakeshore Commons is a townhome and cottage community steps from the Lake Merritt Reservoir boardwalk.

Low-maintenance living with an HOA-maintained yard, a fitness center, and a rooftop terrace. See our [HOA and amenities FAQ](/faq/hoa-amenities) for details on dues and services.

title: The Aurora
content:
The Aurora is a 1,850 sq. ft. single-story plan with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and an open kitchen that flows into a covered patio.

Available at [Cedar Ridge](/communities/cedar-ridge) and [Sunset Mesa](/communities/sunset-mesa).
meta_description: A 1,850 sq. ft. single-story plan with 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, and an open kitchen leading to a covered patio.

title: The Birch
content:
The Birch is a 2,100 sq. ft. two-story home with 4 bedrooms, a flex room on the main floor, and a walk-in pantry.

Available at [Cedar Ridge](/communities/cedar-ridge) and [Maple Hollow](/communities/maple-hollow).
meta_description: A 2,100 sq. ft. two-story home with 4 bedrooms, a main-floor flex room, and a walk-in pantry.

title: The Cascade
content:
The Cascade is a 2,400 sq. ft. two-story plan with a loft, 4 bedrooms, and a primary suite with a spa-style bath.

Available at [Willow Creek](/communities/willow-creek) and [River Bend](/communities/river-bend).
meta_title: The Cascade Two-Story Floor Plan with Loft and Spa Bath | Northstar Living
meta_description: A 2,400 sq. ft. two-story plan with a loft, 4 bedrooms, and a spa-style primary bath.

title: The Dakota
content:
The Dakota is a 3,200 sq. ft. luxury plan with 5 bedrooms, a three-car garage, and a lake-facing great room.

Every Dakota purchase includes two years of the Northstar Classic plan at no extra cost.

Available at [Harbor Point](/communities/harbor-point).
meta_description: A 3,200 sq. ft. luxury plan with 5 bedrooms, a three-car garage, and a lake-facing great room.

title: The Everly
content:
The Everly is a 1,600 sq. ft. cottage-style plan with 3 bedrooms, ideal for first-time buyers and downsizers.

Available at [Willow Creek](/communities/willow-creek) and [Maple Hollow](/communities/maple-hollow).
meta_description: A 1,600 sq. ft. cottage-style plan with 3 bedrooms, ideal for first-time buyers and downsizers.

title: The Fairview
content:
The Fairview is a 2,250 sq. ft. single-story plan with a courtyard entry and a casita for guests or a home office.

Want more space? Compare it with [The Kestrel](/homes/the-kestrel), our largest single-story design.

Available at [Sunset Mesa](/communities/sunset-mesa).
meta_description: A 2,250 sq. ft. single-story plan with a courtyard entry and a detached casita.

title: The Glenwood
content:
The Glenwood is a 1,950 sq. ft. two-story plan with a front porch, 3 bedrooms, and an upstairs laundry room.

Available at [Maple Hollow](/communities/maple-hollow).

title: The Hawthorne
content:
The Hawthorne is a 2,800 sq. ft. plan with a main-floor primary suite and a bonus room over the garage.

Designed by the Northstar Homes architecture team, the Hawthorne has been one of our most popular plans since its debut.

Available at [Harbor Point](/communities/harbor-point).
meta_description: A 2,800 sq. ft. plan with a main-floor primary suite and a bonus room over the garage.

title: The Iris
content:
The Iris is a 1,750 sq. ft. single-story plan with 3 bedrooms, a split-bedroom layout, and an optional sunroom.

Available at [Willow Creek](/communities/willow-creek), and coming soon to Aspen Grove.
meta_description: A 1,750 sq. ft. single-story plan with a split-bedroom layout and an optional sunroom.

title: The Juniper
content: The Juniper was a 1,400 sq. ft. two-bedroom cottage plan. This plan is no longer offered; see [The Everly](/homes/the-everly) for a similar design.
meta_description: The Juniper cottage plan is no longer offered. See The Everly for a similar design.

title: How to Choose the Right Floor Plan
content:
Choosing a floor plan starts with how you live day to day. Do you work from home? Host often? Need a main-floor bedroom?

Single-story plans like [The Aurora](/homes/the-aurora) suit buyers who want everything on one level, while two-story designs like [The Birch](/homes/the-birch) separate living and sleeping spaces.

Visit a model home before deciding — floor plans feel different in person.
meta_description: How to pick a floor plan that fits the way you live: work-from-home space, hosting, and single- vs two-story layouts.

title: Tips for First-Time Home Buyers
content:
Buying your first home is exciting and a little overwhelming. Start by getting pre-approved so you know your budget, then make a list of must-haves versus nice-to-haves.

Read our [financing FAQ](/faq/financing) and the [buying process FAQ](/faq/buying-process) to know what to expect.
meta_title: Tips for First-Time Home Buyers | Northstar Living
meta_description: Practical first steps for first-time buyers: pre-approval, budgeting, and must-have lists.

title: 5 Reasons Homeowners Love the Northstar Classic Plan
content:
The Northstar Classic plan has been a homeowner favorite for years. Here is why:

1. Two years of seasonal maintenance visits.
2. A dedicated service coordinator.
3. Priority scheduling for repairs.
4. Annual HVAC tune-ups.
5. Transferable coverage if you sell.

Ask your sales counselor how to add Northstar Classic to your new home.
meta_title: 5 Reasons Homeowners Love the Northstar Classic Plan
meta_description: Seasonal maintenance, priority repairs, and a dedicated coordinator: why homeowners choose this plan.

title: Energy-Efficient Features in Every Northstar Home
content:
Every new home we build includes high-performance windows, a tankless water heater, LED lighting, and a solar-ready roof.

These features can lower monthly utility costs. Actual savings depend on household usage, local utility rates, and climate.
meta_title: Energy-Efficient Features in Every Northstar Home: Windows, Water Heaters, and Solar
meta_description: High-performance windows, tankless water heaters, LED lighting, and solar-ready roofs come standard.

title: Tips for First-Time Home Buyers
content:
Our updated guide for first-time buyers covers budgeting, pre-approval, choosing a community, and what happens at closing.

1. Get pre-approved before you tour.
2. Visit at least two communities, such as [Willow Creek](/communities/willow-creek) and [Maple Hollow](/communities/maple-hollow).
3. Review [financing options](/financing) and ask about closing-cost incentives.
meta_title: Tips for First-Time Home Buyers | Northstar Living
meta_description: An updated step-by-step guide for first-time buyers, from pre-approval to closing day.

title: Behind the Scenes: Building a Northstar Home
content:
Ever wondered what happens between groundbreaking and move-in day? At Northstar Homes, every build follows a 14-stage quality checklist with inspections at foundation, framing, and pre-drywall.

Your construction manager walks the home with you twice before closing.
meta_title: Behind the Scenes: Building a Northstar Home
meta_description: From groundbreaking to move-in: our 14-stage quality checklist and homeowner walkthroughs.

title: Your Moving Day Checklist
content:
Moving into a new home? Start packing non-essentials four weeks out, schedule utility transfers two weeks out, and keep a first-night box with essentials.

Looking for the printable version? Download last year's [moving checklist](/blog/moving-checklist-2023).
meta_title: Your Moving Day Checklist | Northstar Living
meta_description: A week-by-week moving checklist, from packing non-essentials to your first night in a new home.

title: Spring Landscaping Ideas for New Homeowners
content: Spring is the perfect time to plan your yard. Start with native, drought-tolerant plants, add mulch to retain moisture, and check your HOA guidelines before adding fences or large structures.
meta_title: Spring Landscaping Ideas for New Homeowners
meta_description: Native plants, mulch, and HOA guidelines: easy landscaping ideas for your first spring.

title: Understanding Your Home Warranty
content:
Every new home includes a structural warranty and the Northstar Care home plan, which covers seasonal maintenance visits during the first year.

See the [home warranty page](/warranty) for coverage details, or read the [warranty FAQ](/faq/warranty).
meta_title: Understanding Your Home Warranty | Northstar Living
meta_description: What your structural warranty and the Northstar Care home plan cover, and how to request service.

title: Smart Home Technology Packages
content: Our optional smart home packages include a video doorbell, smart thermostat, keyless entry, and whole-home Wi-Fi mesh. Packages are selected at the [Design Studio](/faq/design-studio).
meta_title: Smart Home Technology Packages | Northstar Living
meta_description: Our optional smart home technology packages include a video doorbell, a smart thermostat, keyless entry, whole-home Wi-Fi mesh networking, and more, all of which can be selected during your Design Studio appointment before construction begins.

title: Warranty FAQ
content:
**What does my warranty cover?** Workmanship for one year, systems for two years, and structural components for ten years.

**How do I request service?** Submit a request through the homeowner portal or call your service coordinator.

**What is Northstar Care?** Northstar Care is our home plan that includes seasonal maintenance visits during your first year. See the [home warranty page](/warranty).
meta_description: Answers to common warranty questions: coverage periods, service requests, and the Northstar Care home plan.

title: Buying Process FAQ
content:
**How long does it take to build?** Most homes take 6–8 months from contract to closing.

**When do I choose finishes?** At your Design Studio appointment, about 4 weeks after contract.

**Can I visit during construction?** Yes, with your construction manager.

title: Financing FAQ
content:
**Do I need to use your preferred lender?** No, but buyers who do may qualify for closing-cost incentives.

**Can I see current rates?** Our lending partner publishes daily rates at [lender-partner.example](https://lender-partner.example/rates).

See [financing options](/financing) for current incentives.
meta_description: Preferred lender incentives, current rates, and how financing works when buying a new home.

title: Warranty FAQ
content:
**Is maintenance included?** Yes. New homes include the Northstar Classic plan, with seasonal maintenance visits for two years.

**Is coverage transferable?** Structural coverage transfers to new owners automatically.
meta_description: Maintenance coverage, transferability, and other common home warranty questions.

title: Design Studio FAQ
content:
**What happens at the Design Studio?** You will select flooring, cabinets, countertops, fixtures, and optional upgrades with a design consultant.

**How long is the appointment?** Plan for about four hours.

**Questions before your visit?** [Contact our team](/contact-us).
meta_description: What to expect at your Design Studio appointment: selections, timing, and upgrades.

title: HOA and Community Amenities FAQ
content:
**Are there HOA dues?** Most communities have HOA dues that fund common-area maintenance and amenities. Amounts vary by community.

**Which communities have pools?** [Sunset Mesa](/communities/sunset-mesa) has a resort-style pool, and [Lakeshore Commons](/communities/lakeshore-commons) has a rooftop terrace and fitness center.
meta_title: HOA and Community Amenities FAQ | Northstar Living
meta_description: How HOA dues work and which Northstar Living communities offer pools, fitness centers, and more.

title: Home Warranty
content:
Every Northstar Living home is backed by a 1-2-10 warranty: one year on workmanship, two years on systems, and ten years on structure.

## Maintenance plans
Homeowners can add the Northstar Classic plan for seasonal maintenance visits and priority repair scheduling.

Questions? Read the [warranty FAQ](/faq/warranty) or [contact us](/contact).
meta_description: 1-2-10 warranty coverage on every home, plus optional maintenance plans for homeowners.

title: About Northstar Living
content:
Northstar Living builds thoughtfully designed homes in walkable, connected communities. Since our founding, we have welcomed thousands of families home.

Explore our communities, such as [Cedar Ridge](/communities/cedar-ridge) and [Harbor Point](/communities/harbor-point), or [contact us](/contact) to schedule a visit.
meta_title: About Northstar Living: Our Story, Our Values, and Our Communities
meta_description: Northstar Living builds thoughtfully designed homes in walkable, connected communities.

content:
Make your new home more affordable with closing-cost incentives from our preferred lender.

Buyers who finance with our preferred lender can bundle the Northstar Classic plan into their mortgage at no additional upfront cost.

Read the [financing FAQ](/faq/financing) for more.
